Metadata.title: Joldosh — tours from Bishkek
Metadata.description: Beach holidays and sightseeing tours from Bishkek, last-minute deals and trips around Kyrgyzstan. We’ll match a tour to your budget and help with the visa.

hero.title: Tours from Bishkek — from <nowrap>Issyk-Kul</nowrap> to the Maldives
hero.subtitle: We’ll find a trip that fits your budget, help with the visa and stay in touch for the whole journey.

features.title: Why travel with us
features.subtitle: Joldosh means “fellow traveller” in Kyrgyz. We’re with you at every step — from choosing a hotel to getting back home.

prices.title: Honest prices
prices.text: You see the final price up front — no hidden fees or surcharges.

visa.title: Visas & paperwork
visa.text: We’ll help you gather the documents and submit them for you — all that’s left is packing.

hotels.title: Hand-picked hotels
hotels.text: We only book hotels that we or our travellers have stayed at.

local.title: Kyrgyzstan insiders
local.text: Issyk-Kul, Son-Kul and Karakol are our backyard — we’ll show you places no guidebook mentions.

cta.title: Not sure where to go?
cta.text: Tell us what kind of holiday you have in mind — we’ll send you a few options within 15 minutes.
